old_problem: The source labels the test Hot Reset but describes `Hot Reset - SBR with training`; the exact reset mechanism, bridge scope and sibling blast radius are not defined. A final lspci snapshot cannot prove 10,000 ordered reset/retrain transactions or reveal an intermediate failure.
disposition_reason: Pending remains because Hot Reset signaling and Secondary Bus Reset are distinct PCIe operations with different invocation and scope; neither EDs nor the generic LTSSM label can choose the proprietary recipe safely. The reset owner must select one authoritative transaction and topology boundary. Once decided, all other fields are parameterized into a lossless 10,000-cycle ledger with a hard first-fault stop and approved recovery.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2100, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2101 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00023-V002 / ee3cb4897dd78b7a was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
A PCIe protocol Hot Reset and software-triggered bridge SBR cannot be assumed synonymous; the owner must define exact LTSSM/NVQual action and expected state sequence.
Map the root port/bridge, switches/retimers, endpoint/GPU and sibling devices; SBR follows bridge hierarchy and can affect more than the intended endpoint.
Freeze expected generation/width, enumeration and retrain deadlines plus permitted AER/error deltas before releasing any reset.
Each numbered cycle becomes eligible only after reset issuance, LTSSM/retrain, enumeration, exact link state, error delta and GPU/host health are durably recorded and accepted.
Ten thousand means ten thousand complete chronological transactions; startup probes, recovery attempts, missing records or repeated failures do not count.
An interlock stops the loop on the first late/failed retrain, downtrain/loss, endpoint disappearance, new disqualifying AER, GPU/host reset, logging gap or safety excursion; never auto-resume.
No LTSSM/NVQual, hot reset, SBR, retraining, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Authoritatively selected PCIe Hot-Reset or SBR 10,000-cycle retrain soak — GATE-CLOSED DRAFT
test_case.purpose: After the reset type is resolved, apply exactly 10,000 approved reset/retrain transactions to the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe hierarchy and prove each one restores enumeration and expected link state without disqualifying platform errors.
required_package: NVIDIA/PCIe owner-signed choice and exact-version LTSSM/NVQual recipe for protocol Hot Reset or bridge SBR
Expected generation, width, LTSSM sequence, enumeration/retrain deadlines and allowed error deltas
Atomic monotonic 1..10000 ledger with durable storage and control-channel interlock
Dedicated SUT, console/power, thermal/power/storage monitors, first-fault aborts and recovery
test_case.test_command: DO NOT RESET until Hot Reset versus SBR semantics are signed. Then preserve complete topology/link/AER/kernel/BMC/GPU baselines and, after point approval, run only the approved recipe with cycles 1..10000. Before releasing cycle N+1, durably record and validate cycle N reset issuance, LTSSM/retrain, endpoint enumeration, generation/width, error deltas and platform health. Stop on the first acceptance or evidence failure; never clear logs, continue a reset storm, replay a failed cycle or auto-resume after control loss.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be finalized until reset semantics are selected. For the signed mechanism, all 10,000 unique chronological transactions must complete within deadlines, re-enumerate the intended endpoint at expected generation/width, preserve siblings and produce no disqualifying PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error; final topology and health equal the approved baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while Hot Reset versus SBR is unresolved. After unlock, PASS requires a lossless ledger of exactly 10,000 accepted transactions under the signed mechanism and target with no stop condition and healthy final state. FAIL at the first reset/retrain/enumeration/link/error/health violation. A ledger gap or recovery/retry substituted as a cycle makes the run BLOCKED or failed per the signed policy, never PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until reset mechanism, exact target/blast radius, link oracle, ledger/interlock and recovery are signed.
Use a dedicated non-production SUT and require immediate human authorization before the 10,000-cycle sequence.
Preserve all error evidence and prevent further reset issuance after any result/collection/control-channel fault.
Stop without retry on first downtrain/loss, endpoint/sibling impact, new disqualifying error, reset, thermal/power anomaly or uncertain state.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed Hot-Reset-versus-SBR disposition
Tool/build/config hashes and immutable hierarchy/sibling topology
Atomic monotonic ledger 1..10000 containing complete transaction/result identity
Time-correlated LTSSM, enumeration, link, AER/kernel/BMC/GPU/console/thermal/power evidence and gap audit
First-fault/abort/recovery or clean final topology/health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first failed/late retrain, endpoint or sibling loss, disqualifying error, reset, evidence gap or control-channel failure, inhibit all further resets and preserve the ledger/state. Do not switch reset type or retry. Use only signed console/power recovery and quarantine the hierarchy/SUT until owner reconciliation.
